content:
name: Factory AA Touch Smoke Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [factory-aa-touch-fw70]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'app/files/tweaks/29_factoryaatouch-*.txt'
      - 'app/files/tweaks/factory-aa-touch/**'
      - 'app/assets/js/build-tweaks.js'
      - 'tests/test_factory_aa_touch.py'
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_factory_aa_touch.py -v
      - run: node --check app/assets/js/build-tweaks.js
      - run: node --check app/controllers/home.js
      - run: node tests/test_real_mzd_builder.js
      - run: python tests/verify_factory_aa_usb.py --output factory-aa-touch-usb-preview
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: factory-aa-touch-usb-preview
          path: factory-aa-touch-usb-preview/
          if-no-files-found: error
      - run: sh -n app/files/tweaks/29_factoryaatouch-i.txt
      - run: sh -n app/files/tweaks/29_factoryaatouch-u.txt
